questions.question: What is the difference between heat and temperature? Give their SI units.
questions.solution:
Heat is the energy transferred between systems due to temperature difference. Temperature is a measure of the average kinetic energy of particles.

**Heat:** SI unit = **Joule (J)** (energy transfer).
**Temperature:** SI unit = **Kelvin (K)**.
questions.knowledgeNote: Heat is a mode of transfer; temperature is the degree of hotness measured by a thermometer.
